Original Sevenfall Angel Chapel infantry barracks RTS building sprite. Compact ivory-stone chapel with gold edges, cyan narrow stained-crystal windows, small halo above rear ridge, folded wing buttresses. Clearly visible OPEN dark personnel doorway at front centre, short broad stairs to ground, low side dormitory wings. No vehicle bay, no crystals in courtyard, no tall power-reactor tower. Orthographic three-quarter overhead55degrees, front toward bottom, upper-left lighting, stylized pre-rendered RTS art with bold readable shapes at64pixels wide. One whole isolated building centered on genuine transparent background, all details contained, no people, vehicles, text, grid, terrain or smoke. Silhouette roughly square, visibly smaller than a factory.
